name: parser-hardening
summary: Make the diff parser count-driven and unambiguous
body:
Hunk bodies now consume exactly the line counts the header declares:
prefix sniffing misread removed `-- comment` lines (SQL/Lua/Haskell)
as file headers and silently truncated hunks. Paths come from the
`---`/`+++` lines (the `diff --git` heuristic breaks on paths
containing " b/"), submodule gitlinks degrade to whole-file units
instead of crashing analysis with E900, and Isomer-Change trailers
parse only from the final message paragraph, per git semantics.
Found by adversarial self-review.
